office_does: A Snohomish County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, small claims, civil cases up to the district-court limit, and protection orders, and is elected by the voters of the court's electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Anthony E. Howard, a District Court judge since 2015, is the only candidate. Elected by Everett District voters only.

candidates.summary: District Court judge since 2015, previously a court commissioner and trial attorney, running unopposed.
highlights: District Court judge since 2015; commissioner 2011-2015; presiding judge 2016-2018 [S1]
Mental Health Court judge 2019-2023; founded a Youth Traffic Court [S1]
Endorsed by all five County Councilmembers and the entire District Court bench [S1]
